The girl in the photo
Everyone in the house guesses. Only one person was there.
the same
surely, definitely
probably, I expect

entries.anchor: m19/story:ja-m19-the-girl-in-the-photo/ja:「けっこんの まえの しゃしんです。」
entries.en: "It's a photo from before the wedding."

entries.anchor: m19/story:ja-m19-the-girl-in-the-photo/ja:「よこの おとこのこは おじいさんです。」
entries.en: "The boy at the side is your grandfather."

entries.anchor: m19/story:ja-m19-the-girl-in-the-photo/ja:「わたしは じゅうななさいでした。」
entries.en: "I was seventeen."

entries.anchor: m19/story:ja-m19-the-girl-in-the-photo/ja:あには めがねを とる。「この かたは だいがくの がくせいでしょう。」
entries.en: My older brother takes off his glasses. "This person is probably a university student."

entries.anchor: m19/story:ja-m19-the-girl-in-the-photo/ja:いま、ぼくは おばあさんの めを よく みる。しゃしんの おんなのこの めだ。
entries.en: Now I look at my grandmother's eyes properly. They're the eyes of the girl in the photo.

entries.anchor: m19/story:ja-m19-the-girl-in-the-photo/ja:おばあさんの こえは しずかだ。「しりません。」
entries.en: My grandmother's voice is quiet. "I don't know."

entries.anchor: m19/story:ja-m19-the-girl-in-the-photo/ja:おばあさんは ななじゅうごさいだ。
entries.en: My grandmother is seventy-five.

entries.anchor: m19/story:ja-m19-the-girl-in-the-photo/ja:おばあさんは ぼくに しゃしんの はなしを する。
entries.en: She tells me about the photo.

entries.anchor: m19/story:ja-m19-the-girl-in-the-photo/ja:おんなのこの めと おばあさんの めは おなじだ。
entries.en: The girl's eyes and my grandmother's eyes are the same.

entries.anchor: m19/story:ja-m19-the-girl-in-the-photo/ja:おんなのこは とても かわいい。
entries.en: The girl is very pretty.

entries.anchor: m19/story:ja-m19-the-girl-in-the-photo/ja:かばんの なかに ふるい しゃしんが ある。
entries.en: Inside the bag there's an old photo.

entries.anchor: m19/story:ja-m19-the-girl-in-the-photo/ja:しゃしんの なかに おんなのこが いる。
entries.en: In the photo there's a girl.
Nobody knows.

entries.anchor: m19/story:ja-m19-the-girl-in-the-photo/ja:ちちは しゃしんを ながい じかん みる。「ははの おねえさんでしょう。」
entries.en: My father looks at the photo for a long time. "It's probably my mother's older sister."

entries.anchor: m19/story:ja-m19-the-girl-in-the-photo/ja:にちようび、ぼくは おばあさんの うちに いる。
entries.en: On Sunday I'm at my grandmother's house.

entries.anchor: m19/story:ja-m19-the-girl-in-the-photo/ja:ははも しゃしんを みる。「きっと がっこうの せんせいでしょう。」
entries.en: My mother looks at the photo too. "It's surely a teacher from the school."

entries.anchor: m19/story:ja-m19-the-girl-in-the-photo/ja:ぼくの あねと おなじじゃない。おばあさんと おなじだ。
entries.en: Not the same as my sister. The same as my grandmother.

entries.anchor: m19/story:ja-m19-the-girl-in-the-photo/ja:ぼくの あねと おなじだ。
entries.en: She's the same as my older sister.

entries.anchor: m19/story:ja-m19-the-girl-in-the-photo/ja:ぼくは おばあさんに はなす。「この かたは どなたですか。」
entries.en: I say to my grandmother, "Who is this person?"

entries.anchor: m19/story:ja-m19-the-girl-in-the-photo/ja:ぼくは おばあさんの ふるい かばんを あける。
entries.en: I open my grandmother's old bag.

entries.anchor: m19/story:ja-m19-the-girl-in-the-photo/ja:ぼくは しゃしんを もういちど みる。
entries.en: I look at the photo again.

entries.anchor: m19/story:ja-m19-the-girl-in-the-photo/ja:ぼくは ちちに しゃしんを みせる。
entries.en: I show the photo to my father.

entries.anchor: m19/story:ja-m19-the-girl-in-the-photo/ja:よる、おばあさんは ぼくを まつ。
entries.en: In the evening, my grandmother waits for me.

A long train ride I did not want to make, and a dance in the park.
Obon — the summer days when families return home
a child
the Bon dance, danced together in the town square
"Watch this."

entries.en: "The Bon dance is easy."
"I am bad at it."

entries.anchor: m19/story:ja-m19-the-town-that-dances/ja:いもうとが わたしに ぼんおどりを おしえる。
entries.en: My little sister teaches me the Bon dance.

entries.anchor: m19/story:ja-m19-the-town-that-dances/ja:いもうとが わたしの よこに くる。
entries.en: My little sister comes to my side.

entries.anchor: m19/story:ja-m19-the-town-that-dances/ja:おとなも こどもも いる。
entries.en: There are adults and there are children.

entries.en: Grandmother's house is very far away.

entries.anchor: m19/story:ja-m19-the-town-that-dances/ja:おばあさんの ごはんは ほんとうに おいしい。
entries.en: Grandmother's food is really good.

entries.anchor: m19/story:ja-m19-the-town-that-dances/ja:おばあさんの まちは ちいさいけど、おぼんは にぎやかだ。
entries.en: Grandmother's town is small, but Obon is lively.

entries.anchor: m19/story:ja-m19-the-town-that-dances/ja:おばあさんは こうえんの よこに すわる。
entries.en: Grandmother sits beside the park.

entries.anchor: m19/story:ja-m19-the-town-that-dances/ja:おばあさんは ななじゅうさいだ。
entries.en: Grandmother is seventy.

entries.anchor: m19/story:ja-m19-the-town-that-dances/ja:おばあさんは まいとし ここに くる。
entries.en: Grandmother comes here every year.

entries.anchor: m19/story:ja-m19-the-town-that-dances/ja:おぼんに みんな うちに かえる。
entries.en: At Obon everyone goes home.

entries.anchor: m19/story:ja-m19-the-town-that-dances/ja:おぼんは かぞくの やすみだ。
entries.en: Obon is the family's holiday.

entries.anchor: m19/story:ja-m19-the-town-that-dances/ja:かぞくの よにんで でんしゃに のる。
entries.en: The four of us in the family get on the train.

entries.anchor: m19/story:ja-m19-the-town-that-dances/ja:それから、まちの ひとが ぼんおどりを する。
entries.en: After that the people of the town do the Bon dance.

entries.anchor: m19/story:ja-m19-the-town-that-dances/ja:でんしゃの じかんは ながい。
entries.en: The time on the train is long.

entries.anchor: m19/story:ja-m19-the-town-that-dances/ja:でんしゃの ながい じかんは ぜんぜん たいへんじゃない。
entries.en: The long time on the train is not hard at all.

entries.anchor: m19/story:ja-m19-the-town-that-dances/ja:なつの おぼんに かぞくで おばあさんの うちに かえる。
entries.en: At Obon in summer the family goes back to Grandmother's house.

entries.anchor: m19/story:ja-m19-the-town-that-dances/ja:にわに おおきな きが ある。
entries.en: There is a big tree in the garden.

entries.anchor: m19/story:ja-m19-the-town-that-dances/ja:ゆうがた、まちの こうえんに いく。
entries.en: In the evening we go to the town's park.

entries.anchor: m19/story:ja-m19-the-town-that-dances/ja:わたしは ながい でんしゃが きらいだ。
entries.en: I hate long trains.

entries.anchor: m19/story:ja-m19-the-town-that-dances/ja:わたしは ぼんおどりが わからない。
entries.en: I do not know the Bon dance.

entries.anchor: m19/story:ja-m19-the-town-that-dances/ja:わたしも まいとし ここに かえる。
entries.en: I come back here every year too.
